cases.purpose: Verify signal spellings and signal option forms, invalid signal and usage diagnostics, and distinct rejection of unsupported psmisc options. Uses an absent process name and never intends a delivery.
cases.oracle: Documented killall contract; invalid input exits 2 and absent name exits 1.
cases.comparison: Exact stdout and status; diagnostics are checked within the script.

files.body.sh:
check_valid() {
  killall "$@" t119_no_such_process >/dev/null 2>&1
  rc=$?
  if [[ $rc != 1 ]]; then echo "valid signal failed: $* rc=$rc"; exit 1; fi
}
check_error() {
  killall "$@" >out 2>err
  rc=$?
  if [[ $rc != 2 || ! -s err ]]; then echo "usage failed: $* rc=$rc"; exit 1; fi
}
for s in HUP SIGUSR1 usr1 sIgUsR1 10; do check_valid "-$s"; check_valid -s "$s"; check_valid --signal "$s"; done
check_valid -sHUP
check_valid --signal=USR1
check_valid -e
check_valid --exact
check_error --bogus t119_no_such_process
check_error -s BOGUS t119_no_such_process
check_error -s 0 t119_no_such_process
check_error --signal=999999999999999999999 t119_no_such_process
check_error -999999999999999999999 t119_no_such_process
check_error -s
check_error --signal
check_error
for opt in -l -q -w -I -r -g -y -o -v; do
  killall "$opt" t119_no_such_process >out 2>err
  rc=$?
  if [[ $rc != 2 ]] || ! [[ $(<err) == *"unsupported killall option: $opt"* ]]; then
    echo "unsupported option failed: $opt rc=$rc"; exit 1
  fi
done
echo parser-ok
